citations.narrative:
The facility did not have complete acquisition records for three degus, one barn owl, two ferrets, two American kestrels,
one great horned owl, one eastern screech-owl, one opossum, and one red fox. In addition, disposition records were not
completed in full for one common grackle, and two Egyptian fruit bats. While the records included the names of the
persons/entities, the missing required information varied (dates of acquisition/disposition, addresses, driver’s
license/license information and state), resulting in incomplete records for each animal.
Acquisition and disposition records, including offspring born at the facility, are necessary to accurately track and identify
animals being used in regulated activities, as well as aid in the detection of movement of animals upon relocation to a new
site. The licensee shall make, keep, and maintain records of acquisition/disposition of all animals that fully and correctly
disclose the required information, as outlined in this section.
Correct by August 30, 2026.

The outdoor enclosure housing one North American porcupine is less than three feet away from the facility’s perimeter
fence line. During this inspection, the back side of the habitat structure housing the porcupine was less than ten inches
from the perimeter fence. Having a perimeter fence in place protects the animals in the facility by restricting animals and
unauthorized persons from going through it or under it, permitting contact with the animals in the facility by unauthorized
animals or patrons visiting the facility. Additionally, it serves as a secondary containment system for the animals in the
facility. The perimeter fence must be sufficient distance from the outside of the primary enclosure to prevent physical
contact between animals inside the enclosure and animals or persons outside the perimeter fence. Non-dangerous
animals housed in outdoor facilities require a 6-foot-tall perimeter fence around their enclosure and must be at least 3-feet
away from any enclosures or buildings, unless an approved variance has been issued in writing by the Administrator.
Correct by September 30, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
